name: Revenaut AI Chatbot
author: Revenaut AI

sections.description:
Revenaut AI Chatbot makes it easy to embed the Revenaut AI assistant across your WordPress site. Paste the Business ID you were provided, and the plugin injects the script on every public-facing page.

Features

  • Toggle the widget on or off without removing the plugin.
  • Configure Business ID from an intuitive settings page.
  • You can get it from signing up at https://revenaut.ai
  • Lightweight footprint — no third-party dependencies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the revenaut-ai-chatbot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Revenaut AI Chatbot, paste your Business ID, optionally adjust the script URL or attributes, and save.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Business ID?

Log in/Sign up to the Revenaut dashboard and activate the WebGPT agent.

Can I disable the widget without uninstalling the plugin?

Yes. Uncheck “Enable Widget” on the settings page and save your changes.

Does the plugin work with caching plugins?

Yes. The script loads asynchronously in the footer and should not conflict with common caching or optimization plugins.

  • Initial release with admin settings and front-end widget injection.
